summary.text: Rachelle Smit (listed by Ballotpedia as Rachelle M. Smit) is a Republican state representative from Michigan House District 43 who has served since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She is a business owner and former Martin Township Clerk.

paragraphs.text: Rachelle M. Smit was born in Grand Rapids, Michigan, and lives in Shelbyville, Michigan.
Her career experience includes owning a business, and she served as the Martin Township Clerk.
Smit has been affiliated with Right to Life, the NRA and the Farm Bureau.
She assumed office in the Michigan House on January 1, 2023, and advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026; in the 2025-2026 session she chairs the Elections and Ethics Committee.
